Sourdough is a naturally leavened bread made from flour and water fermented by wild yeast and bacteria.

Choosing flour

Bread flour with 12-14% protein produces the best gluten structure for sourdough.

  • Use bread flour or strong white flour.
  • Hydration: 70-75% for a starter loaf.
  • Salt: 2% of total flour weight.

Fermentation

Bulk fermentation runs 4-6 hours at room temperature.

TemperatureBulk time
22°C5-6 hours
26°C3-4 hours
